prompt.es: Escribe tres párrafos para tu blog comparando dos lugares.

answer.text:
Lisbon and Sintra are only forty minutes apart, but they feel very different. Lisbon is crowded and lively, whereas Sintra is peaceful and green. Both towns have a charming old centre, and both are easy to visit by train.

The nightlife in Lisbon is great. Such an atmosphere is hard to find elsewhere. The hotels in the capital are expensive, but the ones in the hills near Sintra are more affordable. We booked early, and this decision kept the trip affordable.

We met eight travellers, most of whom preferred Sintra. The former offers energy, while the latter offers calm. This contrast is why I recommend visiting both.

feedback.es: El texto contrasta con whereas, usa both of which o most of whom, sustituye con the ones y cierra con un sustantivo resumidor (this contrast) y el par the former / the latter.

origin.text: Encargo: entrada de blog que compara Lisboa y Sintra, a cuarenta minutos una de otra. Datos: Lisboa es animada y abarrotada, con mucha vida nocturna y hoteles caros; Sintra es tranquila y verde, con hoteles asequibles en las colinas; las dos tienen un centro antiguo encantador; reservaste pronto y eso abarató el viaje; conociste a ocho viajeros, la mayoría prefería Sintra; recomienda visitar las dos.
